tools.description: Your referral code, share link and stats (referred signups, qualified, credits earned and pending). Referral rewards are Surgemesh credits only, never cash, and are coming soon; codes can be shared now. Verified owners only.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Account: plan, verification, credit, sandbox allowance (monthly_allowance, posts_used_this_month, posts_remaining_this_month, resets_at) and settings.

tools.name: update_account_settings
tools.description: Account settings (admin key). trend_opt_out: true opts this account out of contributing to any aggregated trend statistics Surgemesh may create in future (see Terms); none exist today. get_usage shows the current setting.

tools.name: get_onboarding
tools.description: Onboarding status: verification state, remaining steps and the exact next call. Start here after signup.

tools.name: start_email_verification
tools.description: Email a 6-digit code to the account email (expires in 10 minutes, 5 attempts). Then call confirm_email_verification with the code.

tools.name: confirm_email_verification
tools.description: Submit the 6-digit code from the verification email.

tools.name: start_dns_verification
tools.description: Get a TXT record to publish on the account email domain (or a parent domain). Then call check_dns_verification.

tools.name: check_dns_verification
tools.description: Check whether the TXT record is visible; verifies the account when it is.

tools.name: request_owner_approval
tools.description: Email the account owner a one-tap Approve link (24 h, single use). Poll get_verification until verified or denied.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Status of one verification (pending, verified, expired, failed, denied).

tools.name: rotate_my_key
tools.description: Rotate the calling key: returns a new key (shown once) with the same scopes; the old key keeps working for grace_seconds (default 3600, 0 = revoke now).

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Every supported network: status (available, connect_pending_review, connect_pending_setup = coming soon), how to connect it, and the limits enforced on every post (text, hashtags, media count, types, sizes), plus the built-in sandbox test channel. No auth needed.

tools.name: connect_channel
tools.description: Start a one-tap connect for a brand on an OAuth or app-password network (networks marked coming soon in list_networks are refused). Returns connect_url: give it to the account owner to open once. Then poll get_connect_status.

tools.name: get_connect_status
tools.description: Status of a connect session: pending, connected (with channel_id), failed or expired.

tools.name: disconnect_channel
tools.description: Disconnect a channel: erases its stored credentials and revokes the provider token where the network supports it.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell Surgemesh what broke, confused you or is missing (no key needed; with a key the note is linked to your account). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, list_channels, list_posts, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, list_networks, notify_me, get_analytics · Private data: add_channel, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, check_dns_verification, connect_channel, disconnect_channel, send_feedback · Public sink: get_quote, list_channels, create_post, cancel_post, get_topup_link, get_referral_code, start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, start_dns_verification, request_owner_approval, list_networks, send_feedback, notify_me.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, list_channels, list_posts, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, list_networks, notify_me, get_analytics · Private data: add_channel, get_topup_link, start_dns_verification, check_dns_verification, connect_channel, disconnect_channel, send_feedback · Public sink: get_quote, list_channels, create_post, cancel_post, get_topup_link, get_referral_code, start_email_verification, confirm_email_verification, start_dns_verification, request_owner_approval, list_networks, send_feedback, notify_me

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
